subject: chemistry

items.q: Are all plastics easy to recycle and biodegradable?
items.correct: No — many don't biodegrade and are hard to recycle.
items.random_wrong: Plastics are a type of metal.
items.why: Most common plastics persist in the environment, which is why plastic waste is a problem.

items.correct: A mixture of a metal with other elements.
items.random_wrong: Always weaker than the pure metal.
items.why: Alloying (e.g. steel = iron + carbon) usually makes a metal harder and stronger.

items.correct: They are insulators and tend to be brittle.
items.misconception: They conduct electricity well, like metals.
items.why: Ceramics don't conduct and are brittle; composites combine materials for improved properties.
